toolObservations: MCP helper called with wrong argument shape, generic Map root and search-results selectors corrected from actual UI/source; no product fix.
Moon sources text was not present in the image-status group; visual output and actual 1595187-byte native file established loading. The earlier waiting condition did not prove a product failure.
M31 query resolves as displayed M 31; the source badge identifies AllWISE W3 and does not contain the object name. Literal helper assertions were corrected against actual output.

SDK navigation takes a string URL, not a wx-style options object. First run failed before navigation; a subsequent shell attempt used the wrong task directory. Both failures remain in logs and are not product defect evidence.

m31SourceBack.sourceText: 来源与许可M 31OpenNGC — Mattia Verga and contributors当前数据OpenNGC Messier galaxy and nebula subset时间 · 北京时间发布2026-05-01 08:00获取2026-09-10 08:15适用来源未提供许可：CC-BY-SA-4.0精度：ICRS J2000 positions and catalog angular extents· Starward 从指定 OpenNGC 版本筛选 51 个带 Messier 标识的星系／星云，统一类型和名称字段，将赤经／赤纬转换为十进制度并重排为 JSON；派生目录继续按 CC BY-SA 4.0 提供。· 仅含OpenNGC中带Messier交叉标识的51个星系/星云类对象；不表示肉眼可见、天气或山体遮挡原始出处许可说明NASA/IPAC Infrared Science Archive (IRSA)当前数据AllWISE W3 12 µm 巡天影像时间 · 北京时间发布来源未提供获取时间未知适用来源未提供许可：ODbL-1.0（HiPS 数据库）；AllWISE 影像另附声明精度：历史 W3 12 µm 红外巡天；按目标裁切，北向上，东向左· Contains information from AllWISE W3 HiPS (CDS/Aladin; CNRS/Unistra), made available under the Open Database License (ODbL). Starward offers its imagery selection and arrangement under ODbL; individual AllWISE images retain their separate WISE/NEOWISE acknowledgment and IPAC/NASA rights.· HiPS 数据库：https://alasky.cds.unistra.fr/MocServer/query?ID=CDS%2FP%2FallWISE%2FW3&fmt=html&get=record；许可：https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/· This publication makes use of data products from the Wide-field Infrared Survey Explorer, which is a joint project of the University of California, Los Angeles, and the Jet Propulsion Laboratory/California Institute of Technology, and NEOWISE, which is a project of the Jet Propulsion Laboratory/California Institute of Technology. WISE and NEOWISE are funded by the National Aeronautics and Space Administration.· AllWISE 声明：https://irsa.ipac.caltech.edu/data/WISE/docs/release/AllWISE/expsup/sec1_6b.html· 数据版权：IPAC/NASA；HiPS：CDS/Aladin — Thomas Boch，CNRS/Unistra。· Atlas 数据引用：https://doi.org/10.26131/IRSA153；HiPS：https://doi.org/10.26093/cds/aladin/na1n-03· 影像加工：CDS hips2fits；https://alasky.cds.unistra.fr/hips-image-services/hips2fits· Starward selected 51 Messier galaxy/nebula targets and published three north-up ICRS TAN JPEG cutouts per target through CDS hips2fits, with 1-99.7 percentile asinh grayscale stretch; these are processed 12 micrometer survey images, not visible-light photographs.· Historical 12 micrometer survey imagery; it is neither naked-eye appearance nor realtime sky data.· Source-survey saturation and detector artifacts may remain after bounded stretch and resampling.· JPEG display validation does not measure valid source-data coverage; black pixels can represent low brightness or missing data. No validity mask is published.· 此出版物未测量源数据有效覆盖比例；图中黑色可能来自低亮度或无数据，不能由JPEG推定全覆盖或缺测位置。· 星图中的红外切图使用亮度透明过渡和边缘淡化，仅为显示处理；淡出不表示没有天体或缺测。未作淡化的切图可从下载清单取得。原始出处许可说明下载数据
